parsed.summary: Router r3 connects to router r2 via eth1 and provides IP forwarding. It manages three segments: a link to r2 (eth1), a DMZ segment (eth2 with address 10.0.3.1/24), and a segment for sensors (eth3 with address 10.0.4.1/24). Static routes are configured to reach client-side segments 10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24, and 10.0.99.0/24 via r2's interface eth1 with IP address 10.0.23.1.
